subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 1: Ta'if, Isra and Mi'raj, and sawm
source: Written for islamic-studies/y5 lesson 8 (Pupil PDF worksheet: why we fast poster)
intro: Lesson 8: Sawm: what fasting is and why we fast. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: What is sawm?
points: No food or drink from dawn to sunset
In Ramadan, for the whole month
Also no bad words or arguing

passage.title: al-Baqarah 2:183
paras: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous.

box.title: Four reasons we fast. One must use 2:183: fasting was prescribed so that we may gain taqwa.

keywords.def: fasting: no food or drink from dawn to sunset
the ninth month, when Muslims fast
being aware of Allah and careful to obey Him
the meal at sunset that breaks the fast

questions.q: Explain what sawm is in one sentence.
questions.a: Sawm is not eating or drinking from dawn until sunset in Ramadan, for Allah.
To obey Allah and gain taqwa; to feel for the hungry

questions.q: Make a 'Why we fast' poster with four reasons, one with the ayah 2:183.
questions.a: Obey Allah; taqwa (2:183); empathy for the hungry; forgiveness and reward.
Being aware of Allah and careful to obey Him.

questions.q: Stretch: how can fasting help control anger?
questions.a: It trains self-control; the fasting person avoids arguing.

questions.q: When does the fast end each day?
questions.a: A) At Maghrib (sunset). The fast is from Fajr to Maghrib.

questions.q: Fasting is in the month of ...
Think again: what do we gain by fasting?
questions.a: Taqwa, reward, self-control and care for the hungry.
